result.title: Replay for LLM Continual Learning with Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
result.summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) distills domain experts into one student but needs every expert at once. When domains arrive one at a time and earlier experts are gone, the previous-stage student can teach replayed prompts of earlier domains inside every stage. Some pipelines instead store every stage snapshot for a final multi-teacher recovery stage. On five domains with a 1.5B student and five public experts, this paper compares both with joint MOPD. It varies the replay budget and the replay signal. The signal is token-level distillation alone or with alignment of hidden states, attention and value relations. Sequential distillation without replay or recovery is 6.2 points below 208-step joint MOPD on a 14-benchmark average and 3.5 points below on the 11 benchmarks outside safety. Without snapshots, replay toward the previous student closes 3.8 of the 6.2 points when the earlier domains share the replay budget of a stage. With a fixed share of seven replay steps per earlier domain and stage, it closes 5.8 over two training runs. This is level with the 5.9 of recovery from all snapshots, both at its default length and when given as many training steps as the fixed share. Alignment terms on replay steps change the average by about one point or less. If refusal and compliance count equally in safety, shared-budget replay ranks first among the trained configurations, and the fixed share stays at or above recovery. Against the shared budget, the fixed share lowers the score on the newest domain. Recovery lowers this score as well, in five of six cases. The replay steps of the fixed share grow quadratically with the number of stages.

AI.brief_summary: 研究领域逐个到达、早期专家已不可用时，让上一阶段学生充当教师重放早期领域 prompt，并与保存全部快照做最终多教师恢复、以及联合 MOPD 对比，同时变化重放预算与蒸馏信号（仅 token 级，或叠加 hidden state、attention 与 value 关系对齐）。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本的持续学习工作，但「用历史阶段自身作教师重放、以 hidden state/注意力关系对齐作监督信号」可能为 LVR 训练中内部推理状态的监督与旧能力保留提供线索，重放预算分配方式可供核查；与视觉证据筛选无直接联系。
